linking_evidence: a rented high-end SUV from a Southampton, NY rental office was captured repeatedly by license plate readers, arriving the day before and two days before burglaries and driving through town for hours on the burglary dates
Greenwich police found the SUV visited a Port Chester, NY Home Depot three times, where two men bought crowbars, long screwdrivers, flashlights and batteries on security video
a shoe print in snow on 2026-01-19 matches a sneaker seen in the Home Depot footage
a neighbor's camera showed two men on 2026-01-19
cell phone location data placed a phone near a scene
plate reader and phone data tied the five undated 2026 streets to the series
ground_truth.notes: The only source is a local news summary of a 17-page arrest warrant affidavit, not the affidavit itself. The source also reports 11 more New Canaan incidents between July and December 2025 and similar crimes in Greenwich; these are not itemized and have no folders, and the source does not say whether the October 2025 incidents are among the 11. Ten incidents have no full date. The source does not state outright that police tied the 2026-01-23 attempt to the same suspects. The arrest and charge dates fall in 2026, outside the 2019 to 2025 window of the research file.

outcome.summary: Greenwich arrest in January 2026 and New Canaan arrest in March 2026. Warrant arrest 2026-08-28 on 11 burglary counts and related counts, held on 150,000 dollars bond, arraignment scheduled. Final disposition not reported.
